author: Bodostock
text:
Hi Pedini

Sorry to pollute your journal again.

But i would like to ask about the following case. This is how i usually lose money which i cannot understand why.

This is USDCAD which you showed last week how you plan your shorts.

But i had a long trade after price came down and lost the trade.

Hope you can show me some ropes. Thank you.

Qns:

1) As per my H4 chart, is that a correct flip level? Are the FL, FTRs indicated correctly?

2) If it is a flip zone , at first i thought it should be a good level.
Thus, when price engulfed the FL / flip zone, it formed a FTR at the
right which can be seen in my M15 chart. Thus, i longed the pair as per
plan when price came down to it. However, the reaction wasn't good.
Price bounced only for about 20 odd pips and decided to engulf the FTR. I
 didn't expect this and in the end made a loss. So was it not a good
FTR?

3) Then in fact, there was another FTR below my FTR. I thought this was
 the origin of the dp to engulf the FL at the left. And thus i thought
again that price might fake out to here and then bounce back up. So i
placed my stoploss below this DP. But yet, i was wrong. Price just
continued to engulf it.

4) Price eventually went all the way down for the QM at the bottom before staging a strong bounce up.

How would we know that from where you have shorted, price wanted to reach for the QM level rather than my targeted FTR?

author: ZeeDeveel
text:
Hey Pedini, I'm stoked to see you back on RTM. I urge all traders who
read this journal not to bombard Pedini with charts and questions and
instead let him post his own insights and charts from which we can all
benefit. If you put yourself in his shoes, as a successful trader who's
donating his time to help others, having total strangers covering your
journal in questions is gonna make you not want to check your journal.
I'd rather we leave him to it and we can all benefit from the
information he is willing to share in his own time, rather than drive
him away with endless questions. Just my 2 cents.

text:
Dear Pedini

Thank you so much for your reply.

Pls do not say sorry. I should be the one to apologize for bombarding your journal with so much questions. Really sorry.

Not sure if you are good at confusing yourself but i am sure you are
definitely good in putting clarity in people's eyes with a simple line
and a box.

Man, thank you so much..

If i am to read correctly, it should be -

Major swap zone engulfed > a supply FTR created > then price
bounced and engulfed back the supply FTR > a demand FTR was created
> so price was just going back to the demand FTR from where you
shorted.

Thank you so much again.
